scope: Offline production-readiness evidence for durable external-effect fencing, reconciliation-only recovery, exact TEST-A artifact binding, raw publication-manifest byte equality, provider-authoritative READY deployment configuration and exact file inventory, immutable public byte verification before alias mutation, documented successful alias-response parsing, provider-authoritative alias read-back before stable-public verification, and read-only Vercel deployment reconciliation. No provider mutation or live data is used.

controls.requirement: Publication and delivery persist an exact-attempt effect_started marker before provider I/O. Any retry or expired-lease reclaim for the same logical operation is reconciliation-only and cannot create a deployment, mutate the stable alias, retarget a recipient, or resend.
proofs: test/fulfillment/job-orchestration.test.mjs: an external effect marker cannot be rebound to another attempt
test/fulfillment/job-orchestration.test.mjs: delivery retries reconcile only and never retarget or resend
test/fulfillment/vercel-test-a-publication-provider.test.mjs: expired publication overlap creates one deployment and one stable alias through the real adapter
controls.failureMode: Retryable provider_outcome_unknown without a second external mutation; bounded terminal failure after the configured reconciliation attempts are exhausted

controls.requirement: The top-level publication artifactSetId must equal a valid artifactSet.artifactSetId before adapter or provider I/O and remain bound in provider metadata, stable read-back, and receipts.
proofs: test/fulfillment/exact-revision-publication-adapter.test.mjs: exact revision publication adapter rejects an absent or mismatched nested artifact-set id
test/fulfillment/exact-revision-publication-adapter.test.mjs: exact revision publication adapter rejects a provider receipt for another artifact set
test/fulfillment/vercel-test-a-publication-provider.test.mjs: Vercel TEST-A provider rejects an absent or mismatched nested artifact-set id before provider I/O

controls.requirement: Immediately before stable alias mutation, the immutable deployment .publication.json response bytes must equal the exact generated manifest bytes, including formatting and trailing newline; semantic JSON equivalence is insufficient.
proofs: test/fulfillment/vercel-test-a-publication-provider.test.mjs: Vercel TEST-A reconciliation rejects a semantically equal manifest with different raw bytes
test/fulfillment/vercel-test-a-publication-provider.test.mjs: Vercel TEST-A provider resolves exact source bytes before one scoped alias mutation
controls.failureMode: Immediate non-retryable fail-closed rejection with zero alias mutation

controls.requirement: Before any immutable public read or alias mutation, provider-authoritative deployment detail and vercel.json file-content evidence must prove the selected deployment id, project, READY state, exact metadata, immutable URL, and exact routing/header configuration bytes.
proofs: test/fulfillment/vercel-test-a-publication-provider.test.mjs: Vercel TEST-A provider reconciles a fully aliased deployment without provider mutation
test/fulfillment/vercel-test-a-publication-provider.test.mjs: Vercel TEST-A reconciliation rejects mismatched provider configuration evidence
test/fulfillment/vercel-test-a-publication-provider.test.mjs: Vercel TEST-A provider evidence fails closed when missing, malformed, or unavailable
controls.failureMode: Non-retryable rejection for malformed, incomplete, or mismatched evidence; retryable provider-unavailable rejection for transport and 5xx responses; zero alias mutation

controls.requirement: Provider-authoritative deployment inventory must be structurally valid and contain exactly every approved uploaded announcement file plus .publication.json and vercel.json, with no missing, duplicate, or unexpected file paths.
proofs: test/fulfillment/vercel-test-a-publication-provider.test.mjs: Vercel TEST-A reconciliation rejects an unexpected provider inventory file
test/fulfillment/vercel-test-a-publication-provider.test.mjs: Vercel TEST-A provider evidence fails closed when missing, malformed, or unavailable
controls.failureMode: Immediate non-retryable fail-closed rejection with zero alias mutation

controls.requirement: Immediately before stable alias mutation, the selected immutable Vercel deployment URL must return the exact publication manifest and Vercel configuration digest, language redirect, private cache policy, and every approved file digest. Any content or configuration mismatch fails immediately without alias mutation.
proofs: test/fulfillment/vercel-test-a-publication-provider.test.mjs: Vercel TEST-A provider reconciles a fully aliased deployment without provider mutation
test/fulfillment/vercel-test-a-publication-provider.test.mjs: Vercel TEST-A reconciliation rejects mismatched immutable deployment bytes before alias mutation
test/fulfillment/vercel-test-a-publication-provider.test.mjs: Vercel TEST-A reconciliation rejects mismatched immutable deployment configuration before alias mutation
controls.failureMode: Immediate fail-closed rejection with zero alias mutation for any mismatch; bounded retry only for transport or provider availability failures

controls.requirement: Only a documented HTTP 200 alias-assignment response with the exact hostname, a valid uid, and an RFC 3339 created timestamp may advance. Any optional deployment or project field must match the request boundary; exact ownership is established only by provider-authoritative alias read-back before stable-public verification.
proofs: test/fulfillment/vercel-test-a-publication-provider.test.mjs: Vercel TEST-A provider resolves exact source bytes before one scoped alias mutation
test/fulfillment/vercel-test-a-publication-provider.test.mjs: Vercel TEST-A provider reconciles a fully aliased deployment without provider mutation
test/fulfillment/vercel-test-a-publication-provider.test.mjs: Vercel TEST-A provider rejects undocumented or unbound alias responses before read-back
test/fulfillment/vercel-test-a-publication-provider.test.mjs: Vercel TEST-A provider alias evidence fails closed when malformed, mismatched, or unavailable
controls.failureMode: Non-retryable rejection for undocumented status, malformed or unbound assignment response, or malformed, incomplete, or mismatched alias evidence; retryable rejection for provider-unavailable evidence; stable-public verification is not attempted

controls.requirement: Reconciliation must scan every bounded Vercel result page and reject more than one exact metadata match across the complete scanned result set.
proofs: test/fulfillment/vercel-test-a-publication-provider.test.mjs: Vercel TEST-A reconciliation rejects duplicate exact matches across deployment pages
test/fulfillment/vercel-test-a-publication-provider.test.mjs: Vercel TEST-A reconciliation selects one exact deployment found only on a later page
test/fulfillment/vercel-test-a-publication-provider.test.mjs: Vercel TEST-A reconciliation returns no match only after exhausting deployment pages
controls.failureMode: Non-retryable rejection before alias mutation or stable read-back

controls.requirement: Every Vercel until cursor must be a non-negative safe integer, unseen, and strictly decreasing; repeated, cyclic, and non-monotonic cursors fail closed.
proofs: test/fulfillment/vercel-test-a-publication-provider.test.mjs: Vercel TEST-A reconciliation rejects repeated, cyclic, and non-monotonic cursors
controls.failureMode: Retryable provider-unavailable rejection before alias mutation or stable read-back

verification.requiredResult: deterministic PASS with no provider mutation

releaseConstraint: This evidence authorizes only a reviewed release candidate. It does not authorize provider mutation, deployment, alias changes, publication, or live customer-data access.
